libdivsufsort 2.0.1, vendored from https://github.com/y-256/libdivsufsort
(commit above, 2015-10-28, MIT licence). Upstream is CMake-only; the headers
here are the generated ones (config.h, divsufsort.h, divsufsort64.h, lfs.h)
so the sources build with a plain compiler loop and no CMake dependency.
Only the 2019 prebuilt .a files lived in this repo before; the sources did not.
